fit: postoperative visual hallucination events in an advanced Parkinson series
assessment: Two of seven developed visual hallucinations several weeks after bilateral stimulation. These are adverse events in a surgery and medication context, without per-person hallucination frequency or assigned dried fig intake.

fit: qualitative reports of drooling after Parkinson surgery
assessment: Less drooling was described in the two patients still using apomorphine infusion after stimulation. There was no drooling score or assigned raw fig exposure.

fit: qualitative off-period pain after Parkinson surgery
assessment: Off-period pain improvement was described among patients still using infusion. Two patients stopped morphine after surgery. There was no pain severity comparison involving dried date.
